count_definition: 56 explicitly defined responsibility/workstream cards:19 backend/qualification +14 frontend/operations +1 recovered offline tool +11 inactive reference workstreams +11 future workstreams. These are NOT 56 shipped features, unique engines, or guarantees. Some shared capabilities are represented from backend and UI/operations layers and cross-referenced rather than implemented twice.

feature_groups.category: Existing first-party backend, qualification and packaging responsibilities
Future or partially scaffolded product workstreams

status_definitions.existing_and_verified: The named bounded software contract has executed evidence; it does not imply model quality, commercial clearance or production availability.
status_definitions.existing_partial: Implemented code exists, while user-facing completeness or real runtime/provider/quality acceptance remains missing.
status_definitions.existing_but_broken_or_unsafe: Static defects or unsuitable trust contracts are explicitly identified; no unexecuted suite is reported as a runtime failure.
status_definitions.inactive_reference: Source exists under AnalyseFuture for research; its tests/models were not executed and it is not installed in the product.
status_definitions.future: A proposed responsibility, with existing supporting documentation/primitives where stated. Recommended nonexisting paths are clearly separated from actual files.
status_definitions.experimental_or_speculative: Requires evidence and possibly research, resources or infrastructure; no breakthrough or delivery date is guaranteed.

Idempotent webhook and refund behavior
Hard resource controls distinct from concurrency/storage quotas
features.consolidation_or_reuse_decision: Reuse mature payments and preserve conservative uncertain-submission behavior. Current byte/job quotas must not be labeled credits or dollar caps.
features.final_ownership: Product/backend billing owner and platform cost owner; no active billing module currently exists
features.proposed_nonexisting_path: Proposed only: a billing responsibility within apps/api; no module exists yet
features.planning_horizon: Before paid access; conditional one-year product horizon

features.name: Hosted production operations and recovery
features.purpose: Operate a deployed service with TLS, monitoring, resource isolation, backups/restoration, on-call response and controlled GPU scheduling.
dependencies: Hosting account and explicit spending approval
features.evidence: Feasible with resources and operating capability; no hosted production deployment or live infrastructure was created.
missing_functionality: Approved hosting and bounded infrastructure
Real storage and backup/restore drills
Production security/load/SLO acceptance and incident process
features.consolidation_or_reuse_decision: Use the validated CPU packaging and existing durable worker as prerequisites. Local image builds and configuration checks do not prove a hosted SaaS.
features.final_ownership: Platform/security engineer; root deployment entry points remain current, hosted infrastructure path not yet implemented
features.proposed_nonexisting_path: Proposed only: infrastructure/ if an approved provider deployment requires it
features.planning_horizon: Only after real vertical-slice and operational readiness gates

features.name: Asset version library and team collaboration
features.purpose: Maintain accepted meshes/materials/rigs, derived revisions, comments, sharing and role-based access for reusable production assets.
features.evidence: Technically feasible now with additional design and tests; no team/version library is currently shipped.
missing_functionality: Version/asset/team records and APIs
Permission/sharing/deletion rules
Compare/approve/revert UX and supported export lineage
features.consolidation_or_reuse_decision: Build on private project/job history and owner-scoped storage; do not duplicate tenancy or confuse job records with immutable artist asset versions.
features.final_ownership: Product API/library and frontend collaboration owners; current primitives in apps/api and apps/web
features.proposed_nonexisting_path: Proposed only: asset/version/team modules within existing apps; no new directories required yet
features.planning_horizon: Potential year-one foundation, richer teams in year two if demand is proven

features.name: Multi-view conditioned 3D reconstruction
features.purpose: Use consistent multiple observations to reduce reconstruction ambiguity and improve supported shape/texture consistency.
dependencies: A licensed model that actually supports multiple views
New input contracts and fixed evaluation data
features.evidence: Possible in constrained systems, but this project has no demonstrated multi-view workflow.
missing_functionality: Qualified multi-view model and pipeline
Supported view count/alignment and user guidance
Quality/cost comparison against single-image baseline
features.consolidation_or_reuse_decision: Evaluate specialist models rather than submit unrelated images to a single-image adapter and label it multi-view. Additional views reduce but do not guarantee full truth.
features.final_ownership: ML/inference and geometry owners; no active multi-view adapter exists
features.planning_horizon: Investigate in year two after qualified single-image work

features.name: Identity-preserving local edits and recurring characters
features.purpose: Preserve accepted character geometry, proportions, rig and materials while making bounded changes and measuring drift.
dependencies: Suitable local editing models or conventional operations
features.evidence: Template/reuse approaches are feasible with additional art/engineering; general unconstrained generative identity preservation remains experimental.
missing_functionality: Persistent identity representation and controlled variants
Measured preservation outside edited regions
Artist correction and regression acceptance
features.consolidation_or_reuse_decision: Exact reuse of an accepted mesh is available as a future workflow design; independent regenerations and seeds do not guarantee identity. Reference local-edit routes are not proof.
features.final_ownership: Technical artist, geometry/ML and asset-library owners; no active identity-preserving editing service exists
features.proposed_nonexisting_path: Proposed only: reviewed character/asset-edit pipeline within services plus asset-version APIs
features.planning_horizon: Template lane sooner; measured generative preservation over one to three-plus years

features.name: Facial rigging, expressions and speech performance
features.purpose: Provide independently usable gaze, blinking, brows, jaw, mouth interior, expression combinations and supported visemes/lip sync.
dependencies: Suitable character topology and separated facial structures
features.evidence: Artist-prepared constrained rigs are feasible; automatic film-ready facial systems for every arbitrary generated head are not demonstrated or guaranteed.
missing_functionality: Actual facial geometry/rig generation and controls
Deformation and identity tests across expressions
Language/timing/acting acceptance
features.consolidation_or_reuse_decision: Keep body rigging F043 separate. A skeleton, walk clip or lip timing alone does not implement eyes, eyelids, mouth anatomy or acting.
features.final_ownership: Character technical artist and animation/ML specialists; no active facial-performance pipeline exists
features.proposed_nonexisting_path: Proposed only: services/rigging/ or a bounded Blender integration after qualification
features.planning_horizon: Constrained trials around year two; broader assistance is three-to-five-year research, not a promise

features.name: Editable scene assembly and reusable environments
features.purpose: Persist independent objects, placements, units, cameras, lights and relationships so locations can be edited and reused across shots.
features.evidence: Conventional modular scenes are technically feasible with new implementation; general automatic coherent worlds remain research.
missing_functionality: Persistent scene graph and authoring controls
OBJect interaction/scale/intersection acceptance
Tested Blender scene handoff and repeated-shot continuity
features.consolidation_or_reuse_decision: Extend the validated asset workflow and mature Blender tooling. Orbiting a single GLB and viewing a rendered scene do not create an editable production environment.
features.final_ownership: 3D/frontend, scene and technical-art owners; active single-asset viewer stays in apps/web
features.proposed_nonexisting_path: Proposed only: a scene responsibility under services/scenes and product APIs if justified
features.planning_horizon: Modular scene trials in year two; broader world assembly over three to five years

features.name: Neural or Gaussian-splat world representation
features.purpose: Explore view-dependent spatial representations as a separately labeled mode with an explicit editing/export contract.
features.evidence: Research exists externally; this repository has no demonstrated world-generation or splat-editing feature.
missing_functionality: Model/runtime and data qualification
Specific representation lifecycle and controls
Honest conversion/editability and camera-coverage limits
features.consolidation_or_reuse_decision: Do not label splats as clean editable polygon geometry. TripoSR internals using neural fields do not implement a persistent editable world mode.
features.final_ownership: Spatial ML/graphics research owner; no active world/splat application module exists
features.proposed_nonexisting_path: Proposed only: isolated world-representation research; keep any prototype outside active product until accepted
features.planning_horizon: Investigate over three to five years if a concrete user need and resources justify it

features.name: Licensed specialized 3D adaptation and training
features.purpose: Improve measured categories such as adult proportions, style or repair behavior using model-appropriate learning and rights-cleared data.
features.evidence: Feasible with substantial additional resources for a suitable model; no custom training run or owned model result is established.
missing_functionality: Curated lawful dataset and preprocessing
Training/adaptation recipe and artifacts
Held-out proof of benefit and regression/cost analysis
features.consolidation_or_reuse_decision: Do not train a general foundation model from scratch first or apply generic image LoRA commands to an unrelated 3D architecture. Adapt only after baseline errors justify it.
features.final_ownership: ML engineer/researcher plus dataset/rights and technical-art reviewers; no active training package exists
features.proposed_nonexisting_path: Proposed only: training/ after the experiment, rights and budget are defined
features.planning_horizon: Potential focused year-two experiment; larger model programs are later conditional research

features.name: Scientific quality, cost and downstream benchmark pipeline
features.purpose: Evaluate permitted held-out inputs, retain failures and compare geometry, visual quality, identity, deformation, cleanup effort and full cost per accepted asset.
dependencies: Qualified real generation and exported artifacts
features.evidence: A narrow evaluation harness is feasible now once approved real outputs exist; general quality superiority and future research success cannot be guaranteed.
missing_functionality: Actual permitted benchmark corpus and executable evaluator
Real output, Blender and deformation evidence
Cost/latency/VRAM measurements and comparative scoring with uncertainty
features.consolidation_or_reuse_decision: Reuse fixture/software tests as prerequisites but keep them distinct from scientific output evaluation. The proposed 100-item benchmark and 95% valid-job goal are not observed measurements.
features.final_ownership: QA/evaluation owner with ML/platform and artists; existing plan in docs/BENCHMARKS.md, future runner not implemented
features.proposed_nonexisting_path: Proposed only: a benchmark/evaluation runner with versioned private inputs and redistributable reports
features.planning_horizon: Start with the first real vertical slice; deepen metrics through one-, two- and three-to-five-year reviews

limits: This registry inventories responsibilities evidenced in accessible current/history/reference material and stated plans. It is not a claim that every external upstream implementation runs, that all possible latent behaviors were executed, or that all production/security issues are resolved.
